title: Gymnic
summary: GYM'NIC, adjective [Latin gymnicus.] 1. Pertaining to athletic exercises of the body. 2. Performing athletic exercises. GYM'NIC, noun Athletic exercise.

inlines.v: GYM'NIC, adjective [Latin gymnicus.] 1. Pertaining to athletic exercises of the body. 2. Performing athletic exercises. GYM'NIC, noun Athletic exercise.
